newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HMH says Bre-X saga hurts investment.
newsitem.headline: HMH says Bre-X saga hurts investment.

text.p: HMH Gold Mining Corp Ltd said on Thursday that the controversy surrounding the Busang discovery in Indonesia had led to investors reassessing the nation's mining sector.

The company, which has gold production and exploration acreage in West Kalimantan, said the recent debate about Busang's true gold content and the collapse in the share price of Busang partner Bre-X Minerals Ltd had sent shock waves through the Australian and international investment community.

"Not surprisingly, that company's share collapse also triggered reverberations around the globe as to the general security of investing in mining operations in Indonesia," executive vice-chairman Malcolm Stevens told shareholders at the annual meeting.

Stevens said the Busang contoversy may eventually have a positive impact on companies like HMH, which is also listed on the Vancouver Stock Exchange, as investors switched from speculative plays in Indonesia to medium-long term opportunities.

"There may be some temporary drying up of risk funds, particularly through Canada," he said, noting that Canadian investors and bourses had been strong supporters of junior gold explorers in Indonesia.
